posts.title: Keeping a Coding Agent's Context Small Between Pieces of Work
posts.description: Most days I have a lot of Claude Code sessions running at once, spread over several terminal windows and working in different repos. With that many on the go, it gets hard to see which ones are waiting on me, and what each one is actually doing. That's why I'm building pitwall , "the pit wall for your Claude Code sessions". posts.title: How to Publish Agent Evals Developers Can Trust
posts.description: If you ship a developer tool, whether that's an API, a framework, a database or a CLI, agents are already doing some of the work of integrating it, and they may end up doing most of it.
